paper.title: Neural Network-Augmented Pfaffian Wave-functions for Scalable Simulations of Interacting Fermions
paper.authors: Ao Chen, Zhou-Quan Wan, Anirvan Sengupta, Antoine Georges, Christopher Roth

results.system_description: 16x4 rectangular lattice (Lx = 16, Ly = 4), periodic in both directions; U/t = 8, t' = 0; 56 electrons (28 up, 28 down), 1/8 hole doping
results.variant: HFPS with GCNN backbone (about 600K parameters), d-wave-paired mean-field initialization
results.source_location: Table IV, p. 16 (row 16 × 4); also p. 9 text
results.eligibility_evidence: Variational energy of the HFPS on the 16 × 4 PBC lattice at 1/8 doping and U = 8; the paper states the L × 4 lattices are PBC.
results.notes: Variance per site from the same Table IV, column sigma^2/Nsite. Transcribed from the cited location of the versioned arXiv source and checked against the printed token; curator review pending. Parenthesized uncertainties are recorded as reported, with their meaning left unspecified unless the paper states it.
